get.description: Newest tanggalMulai first. search matches noSpk or client. startDate and endDate filter on tanggalMulai. Rows carry totalKuota and totalRealisasi, materials are on the detail endpoint.

overbudgetCount.description: Dokubah whose nilaiRealisasi exceeds its totalAnggaran

summary.description: Over every dokubah the filters match, not just the page

post.description: noSpk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk (400 otherwise) and client is taken from there, a client in the body is ignored. status DRAFT (default) may have no materials. status PENDING releases it and needs at least one. totalAnggaran is computed, realisasi is read from outbound, neither is accepted. noSpk must be unique (409 otherwise), kodeBarang unique within the dokubah.

realisasi.description: Read-only. Quantity of outbound lines whose SPK equals the dokubah noSpk and whose item code equals kodeBarang, counted once the dokubah is APPROVED, otherwise 0

riwayat.description: Submit, approve and reject actions, oldest first

get.summary: Get the bahan of many SPK at once
get.description: Needs dokubah.view. Repeat the spk param (?spk=A&spk=B), 1 to 100 values, 400 otherwise. Returns one entry per requested spk in request order. bahan has the same shape and realisasi as bahan in GET /api/v1/dokubah/{id}, and is [] when the SPK has no dokubah. noSpk is unique per dokubah, so there is never more than one dokubah to pick from.
